mechanism: Amphetamine may reduce medroxyprogesterone contraceptive efficacy through potential CYP3A4 induction and decreased GI absorption, while medroxyprogesterone may increase amphetamine exposure via CYP3A4 inhibition, and combined sympathomimetic and hormonal effects increase cardiovascular risk.
action: Monitor for breakthrough bleeding and contraceptive failure; counsel on backup contraception; assess cardiovascular status and consider alternative stimulant if significant cardiac risk factors present.
